name: Northwind Outdoor
notes: Fictional demo brand, deliberately the opposite of Aurora: warm, rugged, low sun. Two contrasting kits make it obvious in a demo that the composed prompt is really driving the output.

prompt.positive_suffix: rugged outdoor lifestyle photography, natural low sun, earthy green and ember colour grade, film grain, wide landscape depth, authentic unstyled feel
prompt.negative_suffix: competing brand logos, brand names, visible text, signage, urban skyline, neon, plastic props, studio backdrop, alcohol, weapons, gore, political imagery
